meta.name: Power Rangers Ninja Storm
meta.description: A trio of ninja trainees become Power Rangers to defend their school after it is attacked by aliens.

videos.name: Prelude to a Storm
videos.overview: When all the Ninja Academies in the world are destroyed by Lothor, only three young students, Shane, Tori and Dustin are not captured. Their Sensei gives them the powers to become the Wind Ninja Power Rangers and the daunting mission of saving the world.
videos.description: When all the Ninja Academies in the world are destroyed by Lothor, only three young students, Shane, Tori and Dustin are not captured. Their Sensei gives them the powers to become the Wind Ninja Power Rangers and the daunting mission of saving the world.

videos.name: There’s No "I" in Team
videos.overview: When Shane decides to take on the Mad Magnet monster by himself, he learns that it takes teamwork and trust to overcome obstacles and maintain friendships.
videos.description: When Shane decides to take on the Mad Magnet monster by himself, he learns that it takes teamwork and trust to overcome obstacles and maintain friendships.

videos.name: Beauty and the Beach
videos.overview: When Lothor's minions appeal to Tori's vanity, they lure her to a photo shoot then create her doppelganger to help them infiltrate the Ninja Ops.
videos.description: When Lothor's minions appeal to Tori's vanity, they lure her to a photo shoot then create her doppelganger to help them infiltrate the Ninja Ops.

videos.name: Looming Thunder
videos.overview: The others question Dustin's commitment to the Rangers when it seems he is spending too much time with his new motocross buddies, Blake and Hunter.
videos.description: The others question Dustin's commitment to the Rangers when it seems he is spending too much time with his new motocross buddies, Blake and Hunter.

videos.name: Thunder Strangers (1)
videos.overview: The Thunder Rangers use the Tsunami Cycles and their Thunder Megazord to try and defeat the Wind Rangers.
videos.description: The Thunder Rangers use the Tsunami Cycles and their Thunder Megazord to try and defeat the Wind Rangers.

videos.name: Thunder Strangers (2)
videos.overview: The Amphibidor monster tries to drain the city dry. Hunter and Blake reveal that they are the Thunder Rangers.
videos.description: The Amphibidor monster tries to drain the city dry. Hunter and Blake reveal that they are the Thunder Rangers.

videos.name: Thunder Strangers (3)
videos.overview: When Hunter and Blake meet the ghosts of their parents in the Cavern of Lost Ninjas they learn that Lothor is responsible for their parents' deaths, not Sensei.
videos.description: When Hunter and Blake meet the ghosts of their parents in the Cavern of Lost Ninjas they learn that Lothor is responsible for their parents' deaths, not Sensei.

videos.name: Nowhere to Grow
videos.overview: The Power Rangers defend the city against Florabundacus, an evil monster who tries to destroy the world with carnivorous plants.
videos.description: The Power Rangers defend the city against Florabundacus, an evil monster who tries to destroy the world with carnivorous plants.

videos.name: Return of Thunder (1)
videos.overview: Hunter and Blake are fooled by Choobo, who erases their memories and pits them against the Wind Rangers.
videos.description: Hunter and Blake are fooled by Choobo, who erases their memories and pits them against the Wind Rangers.

videos.name: Return of Thunder (2)
videos.overview: All of the Rangers are transported to a sinking island where they battle each other.
videos.description: All of the Rangers are transported to a sinking island where they battle each other.

videos.name: Return of Thunder (3)
videos.overview: Blake and the Wind Rangers must find a way to break Choobo's spell over Hunter.
videos.description: Blake and the Wind Rangers must find a way to break Choobo's spell over Hunter.

videos.name: Return of Thunder (4)
videos.overview: Choobo takes his last stand against the Power Rangers.

videos.name: Boxing Bopp-A-Roo
videos.overview: Marah and Kapri send their alien boxing instructor, the Boxing Bopp-a-roo, to disrupt the Total Trek race that Shane and Hunter are running to prove who is more macho.
videos.description: Marah and Kapri send their alien boxing instructor, the Boxing Bopp-a-roo, to disrupt the Total Trek race that Shane and Hunter are running to prove who is more macho.

videos.overview: The Power Rangers fight against Trayf, the Pig Monster, who traps them in his nightmare world.
videos.description: The Power Rangers fight against Trayf, the Pig Monster, who traps them in his nightmare world.

videos.name: The Samurai's Journey (1)
videos.overview: Cam and his father quarrel because the Sensei is overprotective. Madtropolis drains the Rangers of their powers forcing Cam to go back to the past for a mysterious power source.
videos.description: Cam and his father quarrel because the Sensei is overprotective. Madtropolis drains the Rangers of their powers forcing Cam to go back to the past for a mysterious power source.

videos.name: The Samurai's Journey (2)
videos.overview: Cam travels back in time to the Wind Ninja Academy to gain the powers he needs to become the Green Ranger and to save the younger versions of his parents from the menace of his evil uncle, Lothor.
videos.description: Cam travels back in time to the Wind Ninja Academy to gain the powers he needs to become the Green Ranger and to save the younger versions of his parents from the menace of his evil uncle, Lothor.

videos.overview: Lothor seeks revenge on Cam by sending five monsters at once to destroy the city.

videos.overview: Cam's weird behavior comes at a bad time when Fragra captures two of the Rangers in perfume bottles.
